insights.detail: The demo binds alt+1..0 in _nav.xml, but the key is dispatched with no binding found (handled in <1 ms, no page change). Mouse navigation works.

insights.title: Logging and perf counters take 5% of interaction time
insights.detail: tui.log / _tui_perf.* are called on hot paths even with logging and tracking off; guard them at the call site or make them a single `(( ))` test.
